record.question: A person who believes in God.
record.explanation: Answer C: Theist. A theist believes in God; monotheist would specifically mean belief in one God (C). Independent check: A theist believes in the existence of God or gods; “monotheist” is narrower and requires one god. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/theist. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
